title.narrative: Scoping study protecting and promoting democracy and human rights in the digital era

description.narrative: In November 2021, Denmark launched the Tech for Democracy initiative bringing together governments, multilateral organizations, tech companies and civil society to make tech work for democracy and human rights. In support of this initiative the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) is working to design a new funding facility for a just digital transition. The fund is being launched in a context where democracy and human rights are increasingly under pressure and where digital technology are presenting new disruptions, challenges, and opportunities, both within the field of democracy and human rights itself, but also to the potential of rights-based responses. The proposed funding mechanism is to support local initiatives and change makers in developing countries to respond to the changing context presented by the digital transformation and enhance the use of digital technologies in local responses working to advance democracy and promote and protect human rights in a digital era.
